That enters :261 arm 1 and exits at :264 arm 0. This is a real concurrent-writer path (F), not tampering; the deleted T2-010 test only exercised the corrupt branch. Note T2-010's statement that real concurrency only yields revision_conflict is wrong for this arm, but the deleted test was tamper-only, so its removal was right and the gap is new coverage.
rows.proposal: Add a race test to tests/work-graph/R3a-goal-replay-boundaries.test.ts (it already has the gated records wrapper at :109-116 and same-identity/different-content assertion at :100-101): make the first createGoal pause after its readMany has already returned (so its scope read is stale), let a second createGoal with the same goalId+requestId and another objective commit, then release the first. Expect exactly one committed, the loser rejected idempotency_conflict, one Goal snapshot and one GoalCreated event, zero writes by the loser.

Deleting the arm would leave those statuses unhandled, turning a damaged store into a fall-off-the-end or a fabricated success; the mapping is the rejection, not a defensive extra.
